test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Sushant, buys goods worth Rs. 8,000. He gets a discount of 10% on that article. After getting the exemption, he pays tax at the rate of 7.5%. Find the amount that he will have to pay for this item received at his residence, if the shopkeeper charges Rs.200 for home delivery. Takes.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 8000

Discount = 10%

Tax = 7.5%

**Formula used:**

SP for Shopkeeper = CP for Sushant = [(100 - D%)/100] × MP

Tax will implied on the cost price after the discount.

**Calculation:**

CP = [(100 - 10)/100] × 8000

⇒ CP = (90 × 8000)/100

⇒ CP = Rs. 7200

Cost price after tax inclusion = 7200 + 7.5% of 7200

⇒ 7200 + 540 = Rs. 7740

Final cost price after delivery charges = 7740 + 200 = Rs. 7940

∴ The shopkeeper pays Rs. 7940.
